_readme: Source of truth for the clickwrap documents (Lena's DRAFT_eva-handoff_v0.2). Document IDs and versions are frozen: document_id + '-' + version is the display ID (e.g. TOS-v0.2). Never change a version that has a content_sha256; add a new version entry (legal owner sets is_material_change), then run python3 _build/legal_manifest.py --write. HTML documents: content_sha256 = SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the frozen artifact served at artifact_uri. Inline boxes (B2B-CONFIRM, BILLING-CONSENT): SHA-256 of the exact rendered checkbox text. Labels are Lena's exact text (handoff §2); see notes for the one deliberate change.
